newsitem.title: USA: HP completes $1.29 bln Verifone merger.
newsitem.headline: HP completes $1.29 bln Verifone merger.

text.p: Hewlett-Packard Co Wednesday completed the $1.29 billion merger of VeriFone Inc .
In a statement, H-P said VeriFone is now wholly owned HP subsidiary through a stock-for-stock merger. Based on Wednesday's closing price of 54-11/16 a share, the deal is valued at $1.29 billion.

HP issued one share of HP common stock for each share of VeriFone common stock, resulting in the total issuance of 23,590,235 shares of HP common stock in exchange for all of the outstanding VeriFone shares.
HP also assumed outstanding VeriFone employee stock options and other outstanding equity-based compensation arrangements. HP said the merger will be accounted for as a pooling of interests.

VeriFone, which had net revenue of $472 million in its 1996 fiscal year, will operate as a wholly owned subsidiary of HP, led by Hatim Tyabji, who continues to serve as president and chief executive officer of VeriFone, reporting to Richard Belluzzo, HP executive vice president and general manager of the Computer Organization.
